title: File format
passage: Would you send the artwork as a PDF or an image file? A. I sent the package by express mail. B. The artist lives nearby. C. The printer specifically requested a PDF.
passageZh:
你會用 PDF 還是圖片檔寄設計稿？
A. 我用快遞寄出包裹。
B. 那位藝術家住在附近。
C. 印刷廠特別要求 PDF。
